title: 第二十五章    吃冰淇淋
content_zh:
“你啊什么啊啊！诶呀，真是要被你气死了！”孙依诗一幅恨铁不成钢的样子看着陈木，那表情那样子恨不得手里面又一根擀面杖能够把陈木给彻底敲醒了一样。

    陈木更加的茫然了，自己根本就没做什么好吧？而且孙依诗讲完今天的事情之后陈木并没有觉得有什么危险的啊，反而是自己今天遇到的事情才能够够得上危险的级别吧？

    “小诗，你这是说什么呢，别乱组CP啊。”苏林依及时的截住了孙依诗想要继续说下去的话，在这么说下去，就算是他和陈木之间什么都没有也要被说成是一对儿了，更何况陈木这样的人苏林依就是有些好奇加上一些好感而已，要真说是喜欢什么的还没有达到那个地步。

    “好吧好吧，依依姐，但是我告诉你哦，陈木，你下次要是再在我们找你的时候，结果你不出现的话，我们可是要扣你的工资的！”孙依诗一副我是大小姐的样子说道，这种趾高气扬的感觉看起来也是很可爱的。

    陈木有些无奈，但还是顺应了孙依诗的话，摊了摊肩膀说道：“好的，大小姐，怎么样都听你的，好吧！”孙依诗看见陈木这个有些求饶的样子，顿时心情就好了许多，就连之前心里面的郁闷都已经一扫而空了。

    “这还差不多，你要是消失不见的话，我和依依姐遇到了危险怎么办？而且现在外面这么乱，你就放心我们每天两个人在学校里面？就算是没有什么危险，但是王艺那个人也是挺讨厌的，还有就是，时不时还有一些苍蝇，你知道依依姐每天生活都是很不爽的吗。”

    孙依诗越说越来气，虽然和之前的事情已经没什么关系了，但是她生气的是一直以来的一些不满，那些臭男生真的是烦死人了，特别特别的粘人不说，还非常的没有自知之明，看上去就是想要吃天鹅肉的那种癞蛤蟆，还好意思给自己脸上各种各样的贴金，真是见一次烦一次，孙依诗一想到之前的事情就又气得不得了。

    苏林依似乎已经习惯了孙依诗时不时都要发脾气的样子，见到孙依诗就像是一只炸了毛的猫一样的表现，也显得很淡定，只是尽力的安抚孙依诗：“好了好了，小诗不要生气了，那些人爱怎么样就怎么样好了，而且我们又不是解决不了，更何况现在有了陈木，对于那些人我们就干脆不要理会就好了。”

    苏林依一直都像是一个姐姐一样的哄着孙依诗，陈木有些无奈的看着两个人之间的互动，突然感觉到车子里的气氛有些微妙，但还是继续开车，结果就在经过一家冰淇淋店的时候，一直都在和孙依诗说话的苏林依突然对陈木说到：“在这里停一下。”

    陈木开车的技术果然很好，而且听力也是非同寻常，虽然苏林依一直都在和孙依诗说话，但是陈木还是听到了苏林依什么话是对自己说的，什么话不是。

    于是车子就稳稳当当的停在了冰淇淋店的门口，正正好好不差分毫。

    “来来来，小诗不要在生气了，依依姐请你吃他们家的冰淇淋，小诗不是最喜欢吃冰淇淋了吗？”苏林依不由分说的就把孙依诗拉下了车，这时候孙依诗看到了自己最喜欢的冰淇淋店，气也是消了大半，果然美食的力量是无穷的。

    陈木没有吃过什么冰淇淋，因为他穿越之前的那个世界根本就没有这些奇怪的东西，本想着还是安安静静的在车子里等着两个人吃完出来就好，结果却被苏林依给叫住了。

    “陈木，一起吧，不知道你爱不爱吃甜的，他们家除了冰淇淋还有一些小零食什么的。”苏林依显然是不想让陈木一个人在车里无聊，于是便邀请陈木一起去吃冰淇淋，陈木点点头，把车停了个位置就跟着一起去了。
content_en:
"What are you doing! Oh, I'm going to be so angry with you!" Sun Yishi looked at Chen Mu with an expression of hatred for steel, as if she wished another rolling pin in her hand could completely wake Chen Mu up.

Chen Mu was even more confused. He didn't do anything at all, right?Moreover, after Sun Yishi finished talking about today's events, Chen Mu didn't feel that there was anything dangerous. On the contrary, it was the events he encountered today that could be considered dangerous, right?

"Xiao Shi, what are you talking about? Don't mess with CP." Su Linyi promptly intercepted what Sun Yi Shi wanted to say. If he continues to say this, even if there is nothing between him and Chen Mu, they will be said to be a couple. What's more, people like Chen Mu are just curious and have some good feelings for Su Linyi. If he really likes her, he has not yet reached that point.

"Okay, okay, Sister Yiyi, but let me tell you, Chen Mu, if you don't show up next time when we look for you, we will deduct your salary!" Sun Yishi said as if I was a eldest lady. This arrogant feeling also looks very cute.

Chen Mu was a little helpless, but he still complied with Sun Yishi's words, spread his shoulders and said, "Okay, Miss, I will listen to you no matter what, okay!" When Sun Yishi saw Chen Mu's begging for mercy, he immediately felt much better, and even the previous depression in his heart had been swept away.

"That's pretty much it. If you disappear, what should I do if Sister Yiyi and I are in danger? And now that it's so chaotic outside, you can rest assured that the two of us are in the school every day? Even if there is no danger, Wang Yi is quite annoying, and there are some flies from time to time. Do you know that Sister Yiyi's life is very unpleasant every day?"

Sun Yishi became more and more angry as she talked. Although it had nothing to do with the previous incident, she was angry because of some dissatisfaction she had always had. Those stinky boys were really annoying. They were extremely clingy and lacked self-awareness. They looked like toads who wanted to eat swan meat. They had the nerve to put all kinds of gold on their faces. It was really annoying every time. Sun Yishi became extremely angry when she thought about what happened before.

Su Linyi seemed to be used to Sun Yishi losing her temper from time to time. When she saw Sun Yishi acting like a cat with fried hair, she seemed very calm. She just tried her best to comfort Sun Yishi: "Okay, okay, Xiaoshi, don't be angry. Those people can do whatever they want, and it's not like we can't solve it. What's more, now that we have Chen Mu, we can just ignore those people."

Su Linyi had been coaxing Sun Yishi like a sister. Chen Mu looked helplessly at the interaction between the two people. Suddenly he felt that the atmosphere in the car was a little subtle, but he continued to drive. As a result, when he passed an ice cream shop, Su Linyi, who had been talking to Sun Yishi, suddenly said to Chen Mu: "Stop here."

Chen Mu's driving skills are indeed very good, and his hearing is also extraordinary. Although Su Linyi has been talking to Sun Yishi, Chen Mu still heard what Su Linyi said to him and what he said not.

So the car stopped steadily at the entrance of the ice cream shop, just in time.

"Come on, come on, Xiaoshi, don't be angry. Sister Yiyi invites you to eat their ice cream. Isn't Xiaoshi's favorite ice cream?" Su Linyi couldn't help but pull Sun Yishi out of the car. At this time, Sun Yishi saw her favorite ice cream shop, and most of her anger was gone. Sure enough, the power of food is infinite.

Chen Mu had never eaten any ice cream, because the world before he traveled did not have these strange things at all. He originally thought that he would just wait quietly in the car for the two of them to finish eating, but he was stopped by Su Linyi.

"Chen Mu, let's come together. I don't know if you like sweets. In addition to ice cream, they also have some snacks." Su Linyi obviously didn't want Chen Mu to be bored in the car alone, so he invited Chen Mu to eat ice cream together. Chen Mu nodded, parked the car and followed.
